title: Regulatory Affairs
description:
At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—"Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day."—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 125,000 employees.
Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.
Our values guide how we work:
We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation
Systems, Quality & Regulatory (SQR), a global function within Care Enablement ensuring Fresenius Medical Care's products meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and regulatory compliance throughout the entire product lifecycle. The team supports market access, innovation, and patient safety by driving excellence across manufacturing and supply chain, overseeing post-market surveillance, and promoting continuous improvement and system harmonization. SQR also manages regulatory and quality data governance and provides critical product-related business services across global operations. Join our passionate team and help shape healthcare worldwide
Your Responsibilities:
Lead global regulatory strategy and submissions across U.S., EU, Canada, LATAM, and APAC
Plan, author, and review eCTD submissions (IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, supplements)
Represent Regulatory Affairs on cross-functional teams, providing guidance on regional requirements and development pathways
Provide strategic input on CMC, clinical, and nonclinical documentation for global compliance
Coordinate electronic submissions with Regulatory Operations using Veeva Vault RIM, RIMSmart, and global gateways (FDA ESG, CESP, BfArM, Health Canada, ANVISA)
Monitor global regulations and communicate key changes to stakeholders
Prepare regulatory correspondence, briefing packages, and materials for health authority meetings
Manage post-approval commitments, renewals, and lifecycle activities
Review labeling, advertising, and promotional materials for regulatory compliance
Maintain relationships with health authorities and industry peers
Partner with Quality, Clinical, Nonclinical, and Manufacturing to align regulatory documentation
Improve regulatory processes and support audits, inspections, and other regulatory projects
Your Profile:
Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, or related field required; advanced degree (M.S., Ph.D., Pharm.D.) preferred
RAC certification or equivalent highly desirable; ongoing professional development in global regulatory strategy is a plus
8–10 years of global regulatory affairs experience in drug development and lifecycle management across U.S., EU, Canada, LATAM, and APAC
Strong hands-on experience with global eCTD submissions (IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, supplements)
Proven success in global registration strategy and interactions with FDA, EMA, Health Canada, ANVISA, NMPA, and other authorities
Deep knowledge of ICH guidelines, regional regulations, and global submission standards
Proficiency with regulatory information/publishing systems (e.g., Veeva Vault RIM, RIMSmart) and electronic gateways
Broad understanding of CMC, clinical, and nonclinical regulatory requirements
Strong project management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in a global matrix, handle multiple complex projects, and adapt to evolving regulatory requirements
Our Offer for you:
There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.
Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development
A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

title: Technology Product Manager
description:
Technology Product Manager


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Technology Product Manager works closely with the Business Stakeholders and the FIFA Products & Business Engagement team to define the product vision and roadmap for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.

In this context, the Technology Products Manager serves as the primary liaison between the Business Stakeholders and FIFA Technology and is responsible for the planning and delivery of all Product within the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 portfolio.

The Technology Product Manager is responsible for ensuring that the stakeholder's needs and expectations are met.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Be accountable for the complete lifecycle of the Products in scope; Including delivery, operations, and release planning.
  • Establish and maintain a trust relationship with the Business Stakeholders.
  • Ensure proper alignment between the FIFA HQ and FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
  • Create and agree together with the Business Stakeholders a Product long-term vision, roadmap, and strategy.
  • Build and maintain Product awareness and coordinate the Product Roadmap across Products.
  • Create and maintain the Product backlog according to the priorities given by the Business Stakeholders.
  • Lead the Product Backlog delivery ensuring continuous acceptance from the business throughout the delivery.
  • Ensure the Product delivers high-quality User Experience.
  • Understand the Product requirements and propose innovative solutions.
  • Facilitate the engagement and coordination of all Technology capabilities, as well as the non-IT areas involved, during the Product Lifecycle, such as IT Architecture, IT Security, Legal, Procurement, Branding, among others.
  • Facilitate and drive the actions that lead to the definition of the Product budget, as well as ensuring its efficient management and utilization throughout the Product Lifecycle.
  • Identify risks relevant to the Product and propose risk treatment strategies.
  • Plan and run regular Product Board meetings.

YOUR PROFILE


Education

  • University degree in computer science, Engineering or equivalent professional experience.

Qualification

  • Solid technical background with understanding or hands-on experience in software development/implementation.
  • In-depth knowledge of various delivery methodologies: such as Agile, in particular Scrum.
  • Proven record of successful deliveries of various complexities within Global and Multi-cultural organizations.
  • Experience with working close to UX/UI designer and development teams.
  • Experience in requirements gathering for web applications and subsequent translation of requirements in user stories.
  • Be familiar with hands-on operations in a highly demanding environment.
  • Good knowledge of Azure DevOps (or other backlog management tools).
  • Good knowledge of IT Service Management and Change Management, and solutions that support that capability (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Good knowledge of Power BI or other data analytics solutions
  • Strong experience in Service Management and ITIL Framework is an asset.

Experience

  • At least 8+ years of proven work experience in similar roles; ideally, within Delivery areas or related.
  • Proven work experience as a Product Manager / Product Owner for at least 5 years within the IT field.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent teamwork and leadership skills
  • Excellent written, verbal, and active listening communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Conflict resolution skills are a must.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Proven ability to manage teams remotely.
  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High sense of accountability, trustworthiness, and ethics.
  • Customer and results oriented.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Certification on one or more of different delivery methodologies, e.g., Professional Scrum Product Owner, Scrum Master, PMI-PMP, PMI-ACP is an asset.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: Head of Marketing (100  remoto)
description:
Somos a IPmedia

Uma startup de tecnologia com 9+ anos de sucesso comprovado no mercado de encontros online. Nossa missão é clara: usar a tecnologia para eliminar barreiras, conectar pessoas e inovar sem parar. Com milhões investidos em marketing, um time sênior e de alta performance já em operação, e tecnologia de ponta impulsionando cada movimento. Agora buscamos a liderança certa para nos levar ao próximo nível: escalar tráfego pago e fortalecer nosso pipeline criativo, testes e crescimento orientado por dados.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Head de Marketing para liderar a expansão de nossos canais de aquisição e otimizar nossas campanhas de tráfego pago. Este é um papel sênior, estratégico e hands-on, ideal para alguém que thrive com execução orientada a resultados, capaz de escalar campanhas em social pago, search, programático e influenciadores, enquanto garante alinhamento com criativo, social e PR para maximizar crescimento e ROI.

Requirements

O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar e escalar canais de aquisição pagos (social, search, programático, influenciadores) em ambiente B2C de alto volume transacional, com foco em crescimento sustentável, eficiência marginal e qualidade de usuários.
  • Ser responsável pela operação diária de performance, tomando decisões rápidas baseadas em dados para equilibrar volume, CAC, LTV e payback.
  • Gerenciar aquisição em ritmo always-on, com monitoramento diário de métricas críticas e ajustes contínuos para manter saúde do funil.
  • Estruturar e operar um pipeline agressivo e contínuo de testes criativos, garantindo volume, velocidade e aprendizado constante.
  • Analisar dados em tempo real para identificar quedas de eficiência, saturação, mudanças de comportamento e oportunidades de escala.
  • Trabalhar em parceria próxima com dados/analytics para análise de cohort, identificação de causas raiz e validação de hipóteses de crescimento.
  • Conduzir rituais semanais obrigatórios de performance (review, diagnóstico, priorização e próximos passos), garantindo clareza e ritmo.
  • Atuar como ponto central de alinhamento entre Growth, Criativo, PR, Social e Produto, assegurando execução coordenada em ambientes de alta pressão.
  • Identificar rapidamente gargalos operacionais ou de performance e corrigir sem burocracia.
  • Manter cadência diária de operação: acompanhamento de métricas, check-ins com times, cobranças claras e ajustes rápidos.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade de criativos testáveis semanalmente, evitando gargalos de produção e aprendizado.

O que você precisa saber | ter:

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em B2C de alto volume e alta recorrência, operando aquisição em escala real (milhares a milhões de usuários).
  • Histórico consistente de decisões orientadas por unit economics, indo além de CPA e ROAS, com domínio de LTV, retenção, payback e qualidade de cohort.
  • Profundo domínio de plataformas de mídia paga (Meta, Google Ads e canais emergentes), com capacidade de escalar sem perder controle de eficiência.
  • Vivência em ambientes de pressão contínua, onde performance é monitorada diariamente e decisões precisam ser rápidas e precisas.
  • Experiência em gestão de agências, fornecedores e times multifuncionais, com foco em execução, clareza de prioridades e ritmo.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com habilidade para transformar dados complexos em decisões práticas de crescimento.
  • Excelente comunicação para dialogar com liderança executiva, explicando trade-offs entre crescimento, risco e eficiência.
  • Capacidade de manter disciplina operacional, organização e foco mesmo com múltiplas frentes críticas rodando em paralelo.

title: Network Manager
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Network Manager (NWM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The NWM will work closely with the FIFA Technology teams and the Stadia Teams, as well as other stakeholders. The NWM will understand the stadia legacy network ensuring it will support FIFA's needs during the FWWC 2027. The NWM will also manage the integration between FIFA's Game's Time network and the legacy network.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of network infrastructure for FIFA and Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) offices, FIFA Special Events, and the FIFA Women's World Cup.
  • Review and validate Network Infrastructure designs, ensuring all deliverables—hardware, passive infrastructure, cybersecurity, monitoring, alerting, etc.—are implemented according to FIFA standards across venues and offices.
  • Actively participate in scope definition, procurement processes, supplier selection, and onboarding of Telco and Network service providers.
  • Lead the deployment and implementation of network infrastructure, securing timely availability of components and services, including the commissioning and decommissioning of event venues.
  • Oversee the effective and efficient delivery of Network services for FIFA offices, tournaments, and selected FIFA events. Monitor progress, report status, identify risks, and ensure alignment with IT governance.
  • Perform equipment configuration, testing, handover, monitoring, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Support network-related projects by clarifying requirements, following robust change management procedures, and ensuring clear communication across stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and coaching to team members, including preparing best-practice materials and training resources
  • Create and/or manage KPIs dashboards for operating stadia networks (FIFA's and legacy) for the Telecom Command Center (TCC)

YOUR PROFILE


Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred
  • Proven experience of successful delivery of complex network infrastructure projects

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong technical expertise in telecom service provider networks, wired/wireless infrastructure design and deployment, network integration, and connectivity.
  • Proven experience with WAN/LAN, MPLS, VPN, routing and switching technologies, and multicast operations.
  • Relevant technical certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, CISSP) or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid understanding of structured cabling (copper and fiber) in heterogeneous environments.
  • Excellent consulting, negotiation, communication, and facilitation skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to train and present to diverse audiences.
  • Team‑oriented mindset with the ability to work under tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrates patience, persistence, and a positive attitude.
  • Experience delivering wireless networks in complex, high‑density environments.
  • Grafana, PowerBI and other BI related tools for creating dashboards or collecting data.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portugues
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

Various

  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more)

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: Local Programme Review Committee Secretariat Consultant
description:
Result of Service

Enhanced efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of UN-Habitat's project design, approval, and implementation processes, resulting in technically sound, strategically aligned, and well-monitored projects that contribute to the organization's objectives under the Strategic Plan, with strengthened regional collaboration, compliance with cross-cutting standards, and improved capacity among staff for sustainable project management.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

The consultancy will be home based or based in Nairobi, on a part-time basis for a period of six months.

Duties and Responsibilities

Background to UN-Habitat The United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is mandated to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. UN-Habitat supports various stakeholders, including national and local governments, civil society, and the private sector, to implement the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. Within this mission, UN-Habitat's efforts are organized through regional offices to better respond to the local needs and challenges of urban development. The Regional Office for Latin America and the Caribbean (ROLAC), headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is one such key office responsible for developing and implementing projects in the region, with a focus on supporting national and municipal governments in formulating participative and sustainable urban policies. Over the years, ROLAC has strengthened its collaboration with local governments and stakeholders to promote integrated approaches to urban development, resource mobilization, and policy implementation. ROLAC oversees and coordinate the portfolio across the three sub-regional offices, which implement the projects on the field and liaise with the country governments of region. Background to Consultancy With UN-Habitat's growing project portfolio and the introduction of a de Programme Review Committee (PRC) processes, there is an increased need for technical coordination to ensure that projects align with organizational objectives, regional needs, and global standards. The PRC serves as a critical quality assurance mechanism, ensuring coherence, efficiency, and effectiveness of projects across UN-Habitat's operations. The PRC's review and approval process supports the strategic alignment of projects through co-creation, collaboration across divisions, and mainstreaming cross-cutting themes such as environmental and social safeguards, gender equity, and risk management. The PRC Secretariat, located at UN-Habitat Headquarters in Nairobi, is responsible for coordinating project reviews and approvals across regions. It ensures that projects comply with UN-Habitat's Strategic Plan and Results-Based Management (RBM) frameworks while facilitating knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the organization. As part of ongoing reforms to improve efficiency, UN-Habitat has decentralized certain aspects of its project review and approval processes. The Executive Director has delegated authority to regional and divisional representatives to approve projects with a budget of USD 2 million or below. This decentralization of authority is intended to enhance the speed and flexibility of project approvals, allowing regional offices to take a greater role in managing and overseeing projects while still ensuring adherence to UN-Habitat's policies and standards. In addition, within the scope of the decentralization efforts, PRC Local Working Groups (PRC LWGs) have been established at the regional and divisional levels to handle the review and approval of smaller, region-specific projects. The Regional Representatives or Directors of Divisions chair these working groups, with support from standing members who are responsible for quality control and ensuring alignment with the Strategic Plan. Key responsibilities of the PRC LWGs include:
• Reviewing and approving projects with budgets under USD 2 million within their respective regions or divisions.
• Ensuring that projects comply with UN-Habitat's Results-Based Management (RBM) principles and that cross-cutting issues, such as gender, social inclusion, and environmental safeguards, are integrated.
• Ensuring the co-creation process with relevant regional or thematic experts to provide feedback on project design and implementation plans has taken place.
• Facilitating collaboration between regional offices and UN-Habitat's headquarters, ensuring a "whole-house approach" where operational and normative work streams are integrated. Duties and Responsibilities This consultancy is home based and will support the Secretariat functions for the PRC LWG that supports– The Regional Office for Latin America and the Caribbean (ROLAC) related to project review coordination and approval processes, and alignment with organizational priorities and quality standards. The consultant will contribute on a part-time basis to ongoing initiatives within the framework of UN-Habitat's PRC to enable faster decision-making and project approvals at the local level while maintaining oversight and strategic alignment through headquarters-based mechanisms. Under the supervision of the chairs of PRC LWG ROAF-ROLAC, the Consultant work together with ROAF counterpart and will support the PRC Secretariat function on the in-coordinating project review processes and regional collaboration, with tasks including but not limited to: 1. Project Review and Approval Support: a. Coordinate project review processes under the Programme Review Committee (PRC-HQ WG) and Local Working Groups (PRC LWG). b. Review project submissions for quality, compliance, technical soundness, and alignment with UN-Habitat's Strategic Plan. c. Ensure the inclusion of gender equality, social inclusion, environmental sustainability, and risk mitigation in project designs. d. Organize and document PRC meetings, including tracking follow-up actions and recommendations. e. Clear final documents for IPMR submission. 2. Liaison and Coordination: a. Facilitate collaboration between headquarters, regional offices, and technical experts. b. Ensure regional perspectives and cross-cutting issues (e.g., gender, environmental safeguards) are integrated into projects. 3. Monitoring, Reporting and Technical Support a. Track the submission of approved projects into IPMR and approve (under the level 1) the draft projects for final approval. b. Monitor progress through internal tracking reporting system, identifying gaps, and recommend corrective actions. c. Maintain project documentation and databases. d. Contribute to knowledge products and repositories for organizational learning – in coordination with PRC-HQ WG 4. Capacity Building: a. Provide assistance on project formulation, PRC processes, and Results-Based Management (RBM). b. Coach and mentor staff to improve project quality and compliance. Objectives To support the PRC LWG ROAF-ROLAC Secretariat function by coordinating project review processes, ensuring project quality and compliance, facilitating regional collaboration, monitoring project progress, and building staff capacity to enhance UN-Habitat's project formulation, approval, and implementation. Outputs Monthly summary of activities with the following:
• Coordinated Project Reviews and Approvals: o Number of timely organization and completion of PRC and PRC LWG review meetings. o Documented meeting minutes, recommendations, and follow-up actions. o Number of final clearances of project documents for IPMR submission.
• Quality-Assured Project Submissions: o Number of reviewed project proposals ensuring alignment with UN-Habitat's Strategic Plan, gender equality, social inclusion, environmental sustainability, and risk mitigation criteria. o Number of approved (Level 1) project submissions in IPMR for final approval.
• Monitoring and Reporting: o Documented progress of the regular monitoring of project progress and updates through internal tracking and reporting systems. o Brief on the identification of gaps and provision of corrective action recommendations for the month. o Accurate and updated project records in centralized databases. o Meeting progress reports and list documentation repositories to be shared with PRC-HQ WG.
• Capacity Building and Staff Development: o Number of mentoring sessions/consultations for staff on PRC processes, project formulation, and compliance through coaching and feedback

Qualifications/special skills

Academic Qualifications Advanced university degree (Master's degree or equivalent) in Urban Development, Social Sciences, Economic Development, or other relevant fields. Experience Minimum of 5 years of relevant international experience in project management, urban policy development, or related areas. Experience in working with the United Nations or other international organizations is desirable. Other Desired Skills Familiarity with UN policies, particularly those related to procurement, recruitment, and results-based management. Proficiency in project management tools, including logical frameworks. Competencies Professionalism: Strong understanding of urban development processes, project management, and results-based management. Proven ability to produce reports tailored to different audiences. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely. Planning and Organizing: Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality outputs. Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively with internal stakeholders.

Languages

English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat. For this consultancy, fluency in oral and written English is required. Fluency in other UN languages, particularly Spanish or Portuguese, is an asset.

title: Psicopedagogo(a) - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.
Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.
Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.
SOBRE A VAGA
A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.
Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.
Procuramos um(a) Psicopedagogo(a). Neste papel você irá coordenar, supervisionar, encorajar e avaliar mediadores sob sua responsabilidade. Deve ser alguém que valoriza conversas respeitosas, escuta ativa e justiça.
RESPONSABILIDADES
O que você fará:
Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.
Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.
REQUISITOS
O que você precisar ter:
Pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia;
Experiência com mediação e inclusão de alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
Experiência com alunos do segmento da vaga;
Inglês avançado ou fluente.
Será um diferencial se você tiver
Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.
DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA
O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Senior Media Services Manager
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Services at the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.

Media Operations & Services is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Services Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Accreditation, Accommodation, Transport, Catering, Venue Management, Media partnerships, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media services for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women's World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women's Football Strategy

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support to implement a comprehensive media servicing strategy for all Brazil host cities of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of services across various tournament venues, ensuring a standardised experience for all media professionals.
  • Support to define an efficient visa strategy and implementation of visa procedure for media representatives.
  • Coordinate with logistics to define appropriate custom procedures for media representatives to bring professional equipment in and out of the host country.
  • Support the accreditation process in collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Media Operations & Services team and the Accreditation team.
  • Plan transport services for media representatives across all tournament venues.
  • Support FIFA Zurich HQ to coordinate media Accommodation options and scope services linked to it in collaboration with Media partnership
  • Support in the implementation of Media Ticketing.
  • Support in facilitating a seamless integration between media operations and media services, optimising workflows to deliver the highest level of support and services to accredited media representatives.
  • Support to create a uniformed pricing strategy for catering services.
  • Support to create inventive and budget-conscious media gift and incentive ideas tailored for accredited media representatives.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years' experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years' experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: Analista Financeiro Pleno
description:
Detalhes da vaga
Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D'Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos que tem como objetivo contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D'Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil.
Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros.
Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19.
A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.
Requisitos
Formação Superior Completa em Administração, Economia ou Engenharia;
Necessário conhecimento em Finanças Corporativas, Valuation e Microsoft Office;
Desejável conhecimento em Fiscal e contabilidade.
Atividades
Acompanhamento de desempenho econômico-financeiro, analisando as variações entre orçado e realizado, identificando causas, estimando impactos nos resultados e apoiando a liderança com propostas de recomposição e ganho de eficiência;
Atuação na construção de cenários, previsões e análises que suportem a tomada de decisão, além de estruturar modelos financeiros para novas iniciativas, avaliar premissas e concluir de forma clara sobre a viabilidade e a sustentabilidade dos projetos.

Híbrido.

title: Senior Media Operations Manager
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women's World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women's Football Strategy

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women's World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers
  • Support engagement with local and international media to define requirements and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Implementation of the Camera Loan & repair facilities and any new service

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years' experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years' experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Somos a Rock World uma empresa criadora de experiências que nasceu do maior festival de música e entretenimento do mundo, o Rock in Rio. No Live Entertainment, temos o The Town e Lollapalooza Brasil em parceria com a C3. Na área de Conteúdo temos os espetáculos originais, como o Uirapuru , o The Town O Musical e o Amazônia Para Sempre.

  • Adaptável a um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com prazos desafiadores e constante atualização de informações;

  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de atuar de forma estruturada, com autonomia e responsabilidade sobre processos críticos.

Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar e evoluir o modelo de governança de indicadores, conectando KPIs operacionais, táticos e estratégicos.
  • Definir, padronizar e monitorar métricas de performance corporativa, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia e os projetos da empresa.
  • Consolidar dados de diferentes áreas para geração de análises e insights estratégicos para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Desenvolver dashboards executivos e relatórios de performance em Power BI (ou ferramentas similares), com foco em visão integrada e apoio ao Board.

description:
Buscamos por profissionais que acreditam na educação e seu impacto para transformar vidas, que queiram ser protagonistas da sua história trazendo excelência em suas ações junto a um time que vibra o trabalho em equipe.

Se você quer desenvolver suas habilidades, transformar vidas e trilhar uma carreira na Coordenação, realize sua inscrição.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gestão e desenvolvimento da equipe docente;

O Colégio Anglo-Americano, instituição de ensino de natureza privada, foi fundado em 1919, como British American School, pela educadora Maguerth Coney, com a finalidade principal de atender a filhos de diplomatas radicados na então capital federal.

Na década de 70, já sob a direção do Prof. Ney Suassuna, o Colégio passou por significativas transformações em sua orientação pedagógica e grande expansão no plano nacional e internacional.

Coerentes com a busca na construção do aprender a aprender, com responsabilidade e comprometimento pelo próprio aprendizado, consolidou sua marca nesses 104 anos de existência, uma imagem que integra tradição e modernidade, estando sempre na vanguarda da Educação formando empreendedores bilíngues.

O Anglo-Americano recebe alunos da Educação Infantil ao Ensino Médio e tem seu Projeto Pedagógico definido como cognitivista, com ênfase no sócio interacionismo. O Anglo informa, forma e transforma seus alunos, em processo constante de ação e reflexão, compromissado em prepará-los para as etapas seguintes do aprendizado e para atuação criativa e empreendedora na vida.

Atuação aproximada de 12 meses.

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women's World Cup ("FWWC").
The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:
the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
Implement the Competitions projec, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
Develop the LFS' (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing's seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees' operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams' inspection visits in Brazil as required;
Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
YOUR PROFILE
A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
Strong management and leadership skills
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

  • 1 Conduct internal and external equipment inspection as well as hydro test as required by the regulation.

  • 1 Work area within own responsibility is kept clean and free of hazards.

  • 1 Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to Management System guidelines.

  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).

    Offshore - Handover Offshore - Emergency Response Offshore - Plant and vessel knowledge Offshore - Global Enterprise Management System Offshore - Reports Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding Offshore - Planning Work Offshore - Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment Offshore - Safety Management

Conheça a empresa Rede D'Or


Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

Se você é uma pessoa qualificada, de perfil inovador e sintonizada com o que há de mais atual em sua área de atuação, junte-se à nossa equipe.

Oferecemos mais que vagas de trabalho, oferecemos oportunidades para você fazer a diferença.

description:
Descrição da vaga
Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?
Você gosta de trabalhar com o público e se considera comunicativo?

Vale transporte;
Cesta básica;
Frequentes processos de seleção interna proporcionando desenvolvimento e o crescimento dos nossos funcionários na empresa;
Parceria pioneira com o SESC com o espaço SESC + SAÚDE, oferecendo serviços gratuitos de odontologia e saúde da mulher (preventivo e mamografia) aos nossos funcionários.
SOBRE NÓS
Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.
Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.
E não para por aí
A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.
Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.
O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara
A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 14 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas".
E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 11 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.
Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?
Se a sua resposta for sim, aqui é o seu lugar

Principais Responsabilidades

Gestor(a) de Operações NOC e SOC altamente qualificado(a) para liderar nossas operações de TI e segurança cibernética. Este(a) profissional será responsável pela gestão das equipes de NOC (Network Operations Center) e SOC (Security Operations Center), garantindo o funcionamento eficiente da infraestrutura de TI e a proteção contra ameaças cibernéticas. Principais responsabilidades: Gerenciar as equipes de NOC e SOC, promovendo alinhamento estratégico e operacional. Garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade das redes e sistemas de TI monitorados pelo NOC. Coordenar e supervisionar a detecção, análise e resposta a incidentes de segurança no SOC. Desenvolver e implementar métricas de desempenho (KPIs) para avaliar a eficiência das operações. Elaborar e manter políticas, processos e procedimentos para operações de TI e segurança cibernética. Realizar auditorias regulares para garantir conformidade com normas e regulamentações, como ISO 27001 e LGPD. title: Dynamics 365 F&O Technical Architect (Relocate to Malta/Big 4)
description:
Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft's M365, Azure, Microsoft's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is looking for a talented D365 F&O Technical Architect who will use their expertise and experience for the technical realisation of tasks based on functional designs in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations in particular building and testing new and existing functionalities. This is a dynamic and exciting opportunity to join a growing new business area within a market leading firm.

Job Location: Silema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Include

Requirements

  • A University graduate with a relevant degree within a computing or business discipline.
  • A Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O Core Certification and a Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O Technical Certification would be considered as an asset.
  • Minimum 6+ years' experience working with Microsoft Dynamics AX and Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O.
  • Experience with all stages of Dynamics 365 FO Development
  • A good understanding of best practices including code management (i.e. source control), unit testing methodologies and build processes
  • Strong knowledge on X++
  • Good knowledge of Life Cycle Services (LCS)
  • Experience in using Azure DevOps such as source control, gated check-ins and pipelines.
  • Understand Devops principles
  • Knowledge of Automatic Testing Language (ATL) would be considered as an asset
  • Data migration (Data entities) experience in-line with D365FO data handling processes
  • Experience with interfaces (SOAP, REST, custom services) would be considered as an asset
  • Team player, able to foster positive working relationships across the organisation
  • Resilience and ability to work in rapidly changing environment
  • High sense of ownership and competence to work independently
  • Willing to travel abroad when required

Responsibilities

  • Work alongside the Solution and Senior Technical Architects to help create high quality design and sustainable client solutions and project documentation;
  • Implementation of technical solutions for customer requirements in D365FO
  • Analyse and resolve issues within the ERP system
  • Participate in development, integrations, product support, and platform updates
  • Write and manage technical documents
  • Ensuring all design/technical documentation is kept up to date during the development process
  • Working in an Agile approach depending on the business requirements
  • Working with both on-shore and off/near-shore development teams
  • Deliver all development work as per Microsoft Business Solutions (MBS) standards, ensuring that all software applications are implemented successfully per the project plan: on time and on budget;
  • Be an active member of technical and design working groups within the practice
  • Adhere to best practice and our clients technical standards during all development
  • Keep team and project Manager updated with progress
  • Perform code reviews.
  • Help and mentor developers.
  • Assisting in Technical Interviews.
  • Identify any risks and issues early and raise through the appropriate governance channels
  • To carry out additional duties as may occur from time to time as instructed and agreed by the Practice management team.
  • Represent MBS in a professional and positive manner at all times.
  • The Employee is required to follow our clients Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times.

Microsoft Business Solutions Overview

At our client, your long-term future is every bit as important to them as it is to you. That's why our clients aim is to give you experiences that will stay with you for a lifetime. Whether it's great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you'll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. They are a firm that encourages you to be yourself, values your contribution, and inspires you to act as a role model, always focused on doing the right thing for each other, their clients, and their communities.

This sets out all the different ways you'll be rewarded by our client. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our clients' talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

For this exciting opportunity they have put together a great package that combines a competitive salary with a bundle of extras including allowances, business travel allowances, certifications to support you in your career growth, private insurance, and medical insurance for you and your family.

Don't worry, they know that relocation can be a challenge, which is why they have an extremely supportive onboarding team to help you throughout this process - They provide relocation support for you and your family.
